MESSAGE: Okay ! I’m somewhere in Sweden and I have found this generic lift !
It has got DMG buttons and it’s an Hansen Hydraulisk Hiss AB lift !
Let’s call it !
REALLY LOUD HYDRAULIC MOTOR !!!
Fast hydraulic lift !
Fast levelling !
Uh oh ! It has got pre-doors !
I AM VERY DISAPPOINTED ABOUT THIS ONE !!!! THIS GENERIC IS TOO EFFICIENT, TOO RELIABLE AND TOO FAST FOR A HYDRAULIC GENERIC !!!! This is ABNORMAL !!!!
This thing WAS PUT IN SERVICE IN MARCH 2007, IT HAS A VERY SPECIAL FULL INTELLIGENT LEVELLING SYSTEM, THE CONTROLLER IS A S3 CONTROLLER WHICH IS VERY RELIABLE, SAFE AND EASY TO USE !!!!
Also, the pump is a GMV T2 pump wich is equipped with a really reliable mechanical GMV 3010 valve and a soft-starter !!!
Also, the inspection system is very very safe and the lift goes at 0.3 or 1 m/s when you surf it !!!

And the pump uses the ecological GMV fluid and the hydraulic equipment, the switches and the controllers are stored in a compact cabinet instead of a motor room !!! THIS ONE IS A MRL HYDRAULIC LIFT !!!
Now let’s have a look how the inspection system works.
When you unlock the door with the triangle key, the safety circuit is broken. And this thing won’t return into normal mode until the door is locked !
Also, if the cartop is not at the right floor, you can move the car by using a panel located in the controller cabinet !
And, you could surf it if the light of the button « inspection » lit up !
And the lift is COMPLETELY well-built ! I HATE THAT !!!
And when the lift returns into normal mode, the car goes to the nearest floor and open the doors and the S3 controllers doesn’t cancel calls when the safety circuit is broken !
THIS GENERIC HYDRAULIC LIFT IS TOO GOOD !!! SHAME ON YOU HANSEN HYDRAULISK HISS AB !!!
BUT…
BUT, I WILL MODERNIZE THIS LIFT AND YOU WILL NOT STOP ME !!!!
SO, LET’S CREATE THE MOTOR ROOM AND LET’S INSTALL THE NEW EQUIPMENT !!!!
YES !!!! THE MOTOR ROOM IS ALREADY CREATED !!!!
In this motor room we have a cheap main switch, a cheap Morris hydraulic power unit and a logic cabinet with GUESS WHAT LOGIC ?
LESTER CONTROLS !!!!
One of the STUPIDEST English generic logic EVER !!!
Here we are in the lift pit, wich is very deep.
The cabinet, the oil and the pipes are already removed.
The motor room and the cylinder are linked by this new pipe.
Let’s fill with oil the hydraulic machine and the cylinder.
OH NO !!!! THERE IS A LEAK IN THE NEW PIPE !!!!
HEEEELP !!!! I’M GOING TO BE DROWNED !!!!
But, the pipes aren’t installed yet !!!
Indeed, there is a really heavy duty chassis and there are 2 roped hydraulic pistons !
Also, it DOESN’T TAKE AGES TO LEVEL !!!! GRRRRRR !!!! And there is no Dewhurst !!! BWEEEEURRR !!! I HATE DMG AND SCHAEFER BUTTONS !!!
